summary: The GKE Gateway controller supports Gateway API CRDs v1.0.0.
extended_definition: The GKE Gateway controller supports Gateway API CRDs v1.0.0.

supporting_pages.title: About GKE Inference Gateway \_|\_ GKE networking \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: GKE Inference Gateway introduces the following new Gateway API Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), aligned with the OSS Kubernetes Gateway API extension for Inference : InferencePool object : represents a group of Pods (containers) that share the same compute configuration, accelerator type, base language model, and model server.
GKE Inference Gateway supports streaming inference for applications like chatbots and live translation, which require continuous or near-real-time updates.
Extensibility : built on an extensible, open-source Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension that supports a user-managed Endpoint Picker algorithm .
